name: update_notice
description: Live evidence that Patch_UpdateNotice fires. THE ASSERTION IS A LINE IN Player.log, NOT A STEP, and that is not laziness. This scenario cannot screenshot the window it tests, and --keep-dialogs does not change that: each UIRoot owns its own WindowStack, so a window raised at the main menu is discarded the moment UIRoot_Play takes over, which every scenario does before its first step. Grep the run's Player.log for: RWTH: dismissed blocking dialog CelestialLighting.Dialog_UpdateNotice (suppressed). That single line proves the postfix on UIRoot_Entry.Init applied and ran, that Find.WindowStack was live at that point, that the settings loaded off disk (a dev install has a settings file, so it reads as an upgrade rather than a first run -- ShowIfDue would otherwise have seeded and returned without constructing anything), and that the notice was due. Reaching the end of the steps proves it strands nothing. Run against main for the control: the type does not exist there, so no line. NOTE the report's DismissedDialogs comes back EMPTY despite that line, because DialogGuard.Reset() runs at step 0 and the suppression happens before it -- asserting on that field would pass green forever without checking anything.
